.@Elonmusk HAS BEEN OPEN-SOURCING FOR YEARS

Most companies build closed systems and ask for trust.

Elon has consistently done the opposite:
• Tesla open-sourced its patents so the entire industry could move faster on electric vehicles
• Tesla opened the NACS charging standard, which is now becoming the industry norm
• He open-sourced the X recommendation algorithm
• xAI open-sourced Grok Build
• And the pattern continues
While others protect their black boxes, Elon keeps opening the box.
This isn’t a recent PR move. It’s been a core approach for over a decade.
Real progress compounds faster when the best ideas aren’t locked behind walls.
Open source isn’t just a philosophy for him — it’s a strategy.
